qrList.label: 🎲D20初始化
qrList.message:
/inject id="xiuxian_d20_result"
||
/inject id="xiuxian_d20_accept"
||
/setvar key=d20_tiandao 0 |
/setvar key=d20_pending 0 |
/setvar key=d20_rerolled 0 |
/setvar key=d20_lastroll 0 |
/setvar key=d20_dc 0 |
/setvar key=d20_mod 0 |
/setvar key=d20_detail "" |
/setvar key=d20_final 0 |
/setvar key=d20_diff 0 |
/setvar key=d20_result "" |
/echo "🎲 D20系统初始化完成
天道点：0/5
待结算：0
最近D20：0
全部判定缓存及临时注入已清空。"

qrList.label: ⚙️D20自动处理器
📜 D20状态
✅ 接受结果
qrList.message:
/if left="{{getvar::d20_pending}}" right="1" rule=eq
else={
    /echo "⚠️ 当前没有等待接受的D20判定。"
}
{
    /inject id="xiuxian_d20_accept" position=chat depth=0 role=system "[D20_ACCEPT]
USER已正式接受当前D20候选结果。立即解除待结算冻结，并严格按照已存在的[D20_ENGINE_RESULT]或[D20_REROLL_RESULT]中的RESULT结算当前ACTION。不得重投、不得修改DC/MOD、不得改变结果等级。"

    ||

    /trigger await=true

    ||

    /inject id="xiuxian_d20_accept"

    ||

    /inject id="xiuxian_d20_result"

    ||

    /setvar key=d20_pending 0
}
